library(dplyr)
library(igraph)

site = sites %>% filter(site == "union_sq")
reach_m = 25 * 1000 / 60 * 10   # km/h to metres per minute, times minutes

# Euclidean buffer: straight-line metres from the origin
bg = bg %>% mutate(buffer_m = sqrt((x - site$x)^2 + (y - site$y)^2))

# Network isochrone: shortest path along the streets, plus the walk to the nearest node
g = graph_from_data_frame(edges %>% select(from, to, length_m), directed = FALSE,
                          vertices = nodes %>% select(node))
d = distances(g, v = as.character(site$node), weights = E(g)$length_m)
bg = bg %>% mutate(network_m = round(d[1, as.character(node)] + snap_m, 1))

reached = bg %>% filter(network_m <= reach_m)

bg %>% summarize(
  reach_m = reach_m,
  pop_buffer = sum(pop[buffer_m <= reach_m]),
  pop_network = sum(pop[network_m <= reach_m]),
  overstated_pct = round(100 * (pop_buffer - pop_network) / pop_network, 1),
  area_buffer_km2 = round(sum(area_km2[buffer_m <= reach_m]), 2),
  area_network_km2 = round(sum(area_km2[network_m <= reach_m]), 2),
  bg_reached = nrow(reached),
  pop_reached = sum(reached$pop))
